summary: Medirom Healthcare Technologies filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing that cumulative World ID human verifications via Orb surpassed 50,000 as of July 14, 2026. The release describes ongoing partnership with World to deploy proof-of-human infrastructure in Japan, transitioning to permanent Orb installations at approximately 300 stores. No transaction, shareholder action, or corporate event is involved; it is purely operational progress and business development news. No deal terms, advisors, or recommendations. No special-situation characteristics; the filing is routine operational disclosure.
